name: candlelight-bath-frog-headband-girl
image_purpose: Self-care reel cover and evening lifestyle post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical self-care selfie of an approved adult relaxing in a bubble bath, preserving the green frog headband, candles, steam, and warm low-light atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult blonde woman with damp hair tucked beneath a bright green frog headband, blue eyes, curvy feminine figure, and calm relaxed smile. Thick white bubbles cover the chest and body appropriately while she relaxes in the tub.
prompt.composition_elements: Front-camera vertical reel frame from a slightly elevated downward angle, face in the upper third, legs extended naturally toward the camera and softly visible through water and bubbles. Modern white bathtub, multiple warm candles, subtle steam, and soft water ripples. Vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm candlelight from both sides with very soft overhead ambient glow, golden highlights, soft shadow falloff, peaceful cozy evening mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone 15 Pro-style wide front camera, vertical 9:16, low-light smartphone HDR, soft grain, realistic water and bubble texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 self-care selfie of an approved adult blonde woman with damp hair tucked beneath a bright green frog headband, blue eyes, curvy feminine figure, and a calm relaxed smile. She relaxes in a modern white bathtub with thick white bubbles covering the chest and body appropriately, legs extended naturally toward the camera and softly visible through the water. Multiple warm candles around the tub, subtle steam, soft ripples, iPhone 15 Pro wide front-camera perspective, warm candlelight, gentle shadows, peaceful cozy evening atmosphere.
